title: Can occupational therapists help with developing a visual schedule for my child?
metaTitle: Creating Visual Schedules with Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how the occupational therapists at Pinnacle Blooms Network use visual schedules to increase independence and reduce anxiety in children dealing with autism.
html: Absolutely, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, we profoundly believe in the power of visual learning. Our occupational therapists often employ visual schedules as a valuable tool to help children with autism. This can give your child a clear picture of what their day looks like, reducing anxiety and enhancing their independence. We aim to create a sense of consistency and predictability, to make your child more comfortable and confident with their daily routine.
